verdict.rationale: Docs claim dynamic rule-based access, group-based provisioning, and automatic updates on role change (rippling-it-docs-3, rippling-it-docs-18), which directly matches the story. However, evidence lacks specifics on how dynamic group membership rules are configured, granularity of rule conditions, or independent/hands-on confirmation that group-based app assignment fully replaces manual one-by-one grants. missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule/condition builder UI, examples of dynamic group definitions, independent verification of behavior at scale.
